task.problem: TASK-263 revision 2 / RUN-263-011 / REVIEW-263-005 are publication-effective on canonical main 4963ebc3206a95b2101a69af7dff5a933947c40f. Runtime verification passed 214 focused tests plus git diff --check and the exact production candidate was safely published. The Human then performed the authorized capture against the exact TikTok Shop VN PDP with clean preflight. The carrier successfully reached the screenshot phase but returned TikTokPdpCaseBundleError: 'the full-page screenshot capture failed'. CAPTURE_EXIT was 1 and none of the three final artifacts existed afterward. Therefore the durable manifest consumption boundary was never crossed, the one-shot authority remains unconsumed, and bundle_executed remains false. Audit of current production shows PlaywrightBrowserSession.screenshot() is full_page=True and is bounded by BrowserConfig.timeout_seconds, whose default is 30 seconds. The case-bundle carrier currently calls get_or_create_session(run_id) without an explicit config, so it inherits that 30-second default. The live failure does not prove timeout was the sole cause, so revision 3 must not claim that. It should make the carrier robust against the identified avoidable default-timeout risk using the existing TASK-137 per-call BrowserConfig capability, without changing screenshot semantics, adding retries, changing browser ownership, or introducing a second browser authority.
